about_the_game:
Hunt. Fight. Survive. Kill. Win. The Most Dangerous Game puts a modern spin on the iconic 1924 short story. Dropped onto a stunning tropical island, you have mere hours to prepare—build shelter, craft weapons, and secure food and clean water—before the first wave of hunters arrives. Their mission? Track and kill you for sport.

Survive the elements, outlast increasingly deadly hunters over ten in-game days, and you win. Will you make it?

Explore a Rich, Beautiful, and Deadly Tropical Island

Experience a vast open-world island with dynamic weather, a realistic day-night cycle, and diverse wildlife. But paradise is deceptive—its beauty hides real danger. Some of the island’s natural inhabitants can be just as deadly as the hunters tracking you.

Survive Against Nature, or It Will Kill You

Build shelter, craft weapons, hunt for food, find clean water, and gather resources to stay alive. Every decision matters—because starvation, dehydration, sleep deprivation, and exposure are just as deadly as the hunters stalking you.

And Most Importantly… Fight Like Your Life Depends on It. Because It Does.

You’re being hunted by elite trackers—mercenaries, survivalists, and thrill-seekers out for fame and glory. Each day, their numbers grow, and so do their skills.

Steal weapons, set ambushes, and use stealth to turn the odds in your favor. You’re outnumbered and outgunned, but not outsmarted.

Adapt, overcome, and prove that you are the ultimate survivor.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains moderate acts of violence and violence-based gameplay including knife and gun combat with blood effects. May not be appropriate for children.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)

short_description: Contestant! You’ve been chosen for the most dangerous game. Left on a tropical island, you have ten days to survive—build shelter, find food, secure water. But skilled hunters are coming for you. Will you outlast them? Will the island claim you? Or will prey become predator?
